Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: Relied on and surfaced unverified search snippets from low-credibility sites (e.g., Mabumbe/TMDB snippet suggesting François Périer) without opening authoritative sources. This introduced a false conflict about the father’s identity instead of promptly confirming via reliable bios (English/French Wikipedia, IMDb), risking an incorrect conclusion and causing unnecessary looping.
